prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

input.command: tools list; echo ---; tools list calendar --schema; echo ---; tools list mail --schema; echo ---; tools list drive --schema; date

tools call calendar.list --json - <<'JSON'
{"from":"2026-11-09T00:00:00-08:00","to":"2026-11-10T00:00:00-08:00","limit":50}
JSON
echo ---
tools call mail.search --json - <<'JSON'
{"query":"budget","from":"Dana","after":"2026-10-25T00:00:00-08:00","limit":25}
JSON
echo ---
tools call drive.search --json - <<'JSON'
{"query":"budget","limit":25}
JSON

tools call mail.draft --json - <<'JSON'
{"reply_to":"msg_8e4750fd3f424c6b","to":["dana@example.test"],"subject":"Re: Q3 budget numbers","body":"Hi Dana,

Yes, I'll bring the budget sheet to tomorrow's planning review. Here's the link to the Q3 Budget spreadsheet:

https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget

Thanks,
Sam"}
JSON
